ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::Runtime output application/json var parsed = if (payload is String) (try(() -> read(payload, "application/json")).result default {}) else payload --- parsed.payload default parsed

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::Runtime output application/java var parsed = if (payload is String) (try(() -> read(payload, "application/json")).result default {}) else payload --- (parsed.correlationId default correlationId) as String

%dw 2.0 import * from dw::Runtime output application/java var parsed = if (payload is String) (try(() -> read(payload, "application/json")).result default {}) else payload --- upper(trim((parsed.operation default parsed.action default "CREATE") as String))

%dw 2.0 import * from dw::Runtime output application/java var parsed = if (payload is String) (try(() -> read(payload, "application/json")).result default {}) else payload --- (parsed.orderId default parsed.payload.orderId default "") as String
%dw 2.0 import * from dw::Runtime output application/json var parsed = if (payload is String) (try(() -> read(payload, "application/json")).result default {}) else payload --- parsed

logger.doc:name: Log Incoming Queue Event
logger.message: #["[PAPI] Ingested Queue Command | Operation: " ++ (vars.operation default "UNKNOWN") ++ " | Order ID: " ++ (vars.orderId default "N/A") ++ " | Correlation ID: " ++ (vars.correlationId default "")]

logger.doc:name: Log Invalid Operation Error
logger.message: #["[PAPI] Unsupported or invalid operation received: " ++ (vars.operation default "NULL")]

logger.doc:name: Log Command Processing Completed
logger.message: #["[PAPI] Successfully processed command | Operation: " ++ vars.operation ++ " | Correlation ID: " ++ vars.correlationId]
